the root mean square amplitude of a channel is between {{rms_uv_min}} and {{rms_uv_max}} microvolts, the range a cortical electrode records
params: {"sql": "SELECT lid_text(lid_from_uuid(lid)) AS offender FROM gold_channel_quality WHERE rms_uv < {{rms_uv_min}} OR rms_uv > {{rms_uv_max}} ORDER BY rms_uv DESC", "rms_uv_min": 1, "rms_uv_max": 1000}

control: less than {{line_noise_max}} of a channel's power sits at the mains frequency
params: {"sql": "SELECT lid_text(lid_from_uuid(lid)) AS offender FROM gold_channel_quality WHERE line_noise_ratio >= {{line_noise_max}} ORDER BY line_noise_ratio DESC", "line_noise_max": 0.5}

control: a subject records events at between {{low_multiple}} and {{high_multiple}} times the median rate of its experiment
params: {"sql": "WITH rate AS (SELECT experiment, subject_pid, 60.0 * n_events / nullif(duration_s, 0) AS per_minute FROM gold_experiment_summary), band AS (SELECT experiment, median(per_minute) AS middle FROM rate GROUP BY experiment) SELECT r.experiment || ' ' || r.subject_pid AS offender FROM rate r JOIN band b USING (experiment) WHERE r.per_minute < {{low_multiple}} * b.middle OR r.per_minute > {{high_multiple}} * b.middle ORDER BY r.per_minute DESC", "low_multiple": 0.5, "high_multiple": 2}
